notes: Annual beats for 2026-27 and 2027-28. Recurring events give the 2026-27 instance in dateOrRange and the pattern in notes. Many 2027-28 dates are projected from the usual weekday pattern and flagged low confidence; web search budget ran out during research, so venue/date items not backed by a 2026 source are marked.

events.name: July 1 membership changes and fiscal year start (2026)
events.notes: Realignment moves take effect July 1. 2026: Pac-12 relaunch with Boise State, Colorado State, Fresno State, San Diego State, Utah State, Texas State and Gonzaga; Mountain West adds UTEP and Hawaii (full), NDSU and NIU (football-only), UC Davis (non-football); Louisiana Tech moves C-USA to Sun Belt; Sacramento State joins the MAC (football-only); NIU joins the Horizon League. Also the start of year 2 of House-settlement revenue sharing.

events.name: College football Week 0 (2026 season opens)
events.notes: Last Saturday of August. First season of the SEC nine-game schedule and of the ACC move to nine games.

events.name: Big 12 commissioner search
events.notes: Yormark announced his exit 2026-10-30, effective 2027-01-31 (to RedBird/AC Milan). The Board of Directors (chair: Kansas chancellor Douglas Girod) runs the national search. No successor named as of 2026-11-25.

events.name: Football early signing period
events.notes: Opens the first Wednesday of December and runs 3 days (pattern; 2026 dates not verified).

events.name: FBS conference championship weekend
events.notes: Friday/Saturday after rivalry week. Saturday Dec 5: SEC (Atlanta), Big Ten (Indianapolis), Big 12 (Arlington), ACC (Charlotte), MAC (Detroit). Pac-12, Mountain West, American, C-USA and Sun Belt games are at campus sites (higher seed), split across Fri Dec 4 and Sat Dec 5; exact day per game not verified.
